elements.motion: A slow breeze ripples across the northern wildflower bank, tilting the painted red poppy heads, white daisies and tall golden-green grass blades a few pixels right and smoothly back in place. Hold the wooden wattle fence, cave rockwork and open lawn below completely still.

Keep the wooden fence on the left and the open meadow turf below completely still.

elements.motion: A warm breeze travels down the sweeping northeast bank of red poppies, white daisies and long golden grass blades, bowing each painted tuft gently toward the lower left and letting it rise back.
